description: Architecture review R4. Uses of the default equality (Equals, ==, keyed collections and LINQ operators without a comparer) on types derived from GPC.Model.ModelObject, outside the equality members, checked by tools/EqualityAudit in build/Verify.ps1. A new use states its intent instead: ModelObjectIdentityComparer for identity, ContentEquals for content. Count is the number of uses in the member.
